source_sections.title: Personal information, listening and key vocabulary
verified_content: Unit objectives include listening for specific information, role play and personal-information language.
Vocabulary explicitly defines biometric, passport, processing time, minor, appointment, expired, in person and document.
The listening comprehension questions are present, but the listening passage itself is not included beside them in the supplied extraction.

source_sections.title: Prediction and reading a formal form
verified_content: Prediction guidance uses title, subheadings, visually prominent words and quick skimming before detailed reading.
The sample administrative form contains sections for personal details, parents, celebrant, the other party, supporting documents and a declaration.
The form asks for items such as forename, surname, marital status, date and country of birth, and residential address.

source_sections.title: Formal-form vocabulary and integrity
verified_content: The sample form includes document checks and a declaration about correctness and genuineness.
Vocabulary exercise uses proposed, bride, bridegroom, celebrant, notice and solemnise.

source_sections.title: Conjunctions
verified_content: Coordinating conjunction examples include and, but, or, nor, yet, for and so.
Subordinating conjunction examples include because, although, if, unless, while, before and after.
The source includes sentence-combination exercises using conjunctions.

source_sections.title: Passive voice and application writing
verified_content: The source includes passive-voice completion exercises.
The writing task asks the learner to complete a passport application carefully, truthfully and with a signature.
A project asks learners to research and write an informational text.
